newsitem.title: FINLAND: Cultor sells Spain Ewos unit to Provimi.
newsitem.headline: Cultor sells Spain Ewos unit to Provimi.

text.p: Finnish sweetener, feeds and bakery group Cultor Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it sold its Spanish subsidiary Ewos SA to Provimi Holding b.v. of the Netherlands in a deal without impact on Cultor's 1997 earnings.
"In line with its strategic focus on salmon feeds, Cultor's fish feed division, Ewos, has sold its Spanish subsidiary, Ewos SA, to the Dutch company Provimi Holding b.v.," Cultor said.
The deal comprised fish feed businesses in Spain and Greece with combined net sales of about 60 million markka.
Provimi is the animal nutrition division of French agrobusiness group Eridania Beghin-Say, Cultor said.

For Ewos, the world's second largest producer of salmon feed, the divestment was a further step in its decision to focus on production in Norway, Chile, Canada and the United Kingdom, it said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
